articles.title: Jupiter: The Giant That Almost Became a Star!
articles.summary: Imagine a planet so huge it could swallow 1,300 Earths! Jupiter is a wild world with a storm bigger than our whole planet and a day that lasts only 10 hours. Buckle up for a tour of this gas giant.

articles.title: Australia: A Continent Full of Surprises and Deadly Creatures!
articles.summary: Did you know Australia is the only country that's also a whole continent? It's home to kangaroos, the world's largest rock, and some of the deadliest animals on Earth. Plus, a quarter of its people were born in other countries!

articles.title: Tennis Stars Team Up for a Surprise Protest at the French Open!
articles.summary: Top tennis players like Aryna Sabalenka and Coco Gauff cut their press time short at the French Open. They want a bigger slice of the prize money pie. Even the world number one joined in—find out why they're making noise.
